title: BEACON D5 authoritative damage-assessment overlay — Copernicus EMS (FR-D4-5, FEV-24)
description: The wire shape of the post-event damage-overlay layer (src/application/coordination/ems-overlay.ts). EMS here is the Copernicus Emergency MANAGEMENT Service (rapid mapping), not Emergency Medical Services — there is no patient, transport or casualty concept in this document and none may be added (finding F-150). Every product view is a LINK-OUT: `viewUrl` is an https product page BEACON never dereferences, and no product geometry is carried, rehosted or re-derived, so a foreign polygon can never reach the exposure engine (the F-48 lesson). `provider`, `licence` and `producedAt` are REQUIRED — FEV-24's attribution and production-date labels are structural, not render-time options.

products.description: Renderable products, ascending by production date then product id.

attribution.description: Distinct `provider — licence` credits every render site shows.

asOf.description: Injected as-of instant every ageDays is measured against.

rejected.description: Products excluded rather than mis-labelled (flag, never merge).

areaOfInterest.description: A PLACE label, never a person.

producedAt.description: REQUIRED by FEV-24 — an undated overlay may not be shown.

provider.description: REQUIRED by FEV-24 — an unattributed overlay may not be shown.

viewUrl.description: Link-only product page; never fetched by BEACON.

ageDays.description: Whole days between production and asOf; never negative (future-dated products are rejected).

productionLabel.description: The mandatory FEV-24 label, assembled from the product's own fields.
